caption: Castello di Fontanellato, Fontanellato
composition: Square brick Renaissance fortress in a wide water moat · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The viewpoint is from the grassy bank of the moat on a calm morning, the square brick fortress filling the frame. The four round corner towers and crenellated curtain walls stand at the center, the entrance bridge crossing the water at the right, while mature trees close the left side. The modelled 23 September 2026, 10:30 light is soft and even, and the fortress doubles itself in the mirror-still moat below.
